cold.timingScope: pooled track-entry resolve times; use perBatchEntry for track-specific latency

warm.timingScope: pooled track-entry resolve times; use perBatchEntry for track-specific latency

cold.resourceScope: RSS values are process lifetime high-water observations; not per-batch memory usage

warm.resourceScope: RSS values are process lifetime high-water observations; not per-batch memory usage

balanced.instrumentedMetricNote: Instrumented Rust send-attempt counters cover only listed native send sites; they do not count redirect hops or yt-dlp internal HTTP and are not physical HTTP request totals. yt-dlp values count successful child starts. Match preparation/assessment are synchronous elapsed-time sums, not CPU time. The separate matching-stage CPU fields use CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID where supported; they cover only observed current-thread intervals and are null when no clock observations were made. They are not total process or async-worker CPU. Site coverage is frozen in the diagnostic report.
balanced.traceMeasurementNote: observedResolverExtractionBudgetCounter is the maximum of emitted cumulative counter snapshots, not a physical extractor or HTTP request count; zero snapshots do not mean no extraction when logical extraction_start events are present. Shared lookup events are joined only when one native operation owns the lookup; ambiguous consumers are left unassigned.

excludes: yt-dlp internal requests, retries, and redirects

matchingElapsed.meaning: synchronous wall-clock elapsed in prepare and assess_prepared

matchingThreadCpu.scope: calling thread during synchronous prepare and assess_prepared
matchingThreadCpu.unavailable: null elapsed and zero observations when unsupported or clock reads fail

instrumentedMetricsCoverage.scopeNote: Any overlapping instrumented work in this process is included; windows are not exclusive operation attribution

ytDlpSuccessfulSpawns.meaning: successful child process starts from acquisition run_tool_until

note: Failures remain in attempt denominators; p95 is withheld unless >=20 measured timing samples. Trace fields count allowlisted logical events and observed resolver counter snapshots only. Instrumented Rust send attempts cover enumerated native sites; redirects and yt-dlp internal HTTP are opaque, so these are not physical HTTP request totals. Batch entries are sequential in one diagnostic process and Store; batch CPU is cumulative, while maxRSS is a process lifetime high-water observation at batch end, not per-entry or additive. Matching preparation/assessment values are synchronous elapsed-time sums, not CPU. Concurrent phase duration samples are not additive.
